title: A tag must be separated from the flow sequence it marks
notes: The tag `!a` ends at `[`: a flow indicator is not a tag character (production 40 takes the characters of a local tag from the URI characters, minus `!` and the flow indicators). In a flow node, properties are followed by white space and then the content (production 161), or by nothing at all, an empty node; a collection cannot follow an empty node. So `[` is the first character that cannot belong, column 3. The control with a space, `!a [b]`, is valid (parse/tag-separated-from-flow-sequence-by-a-space).

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a tag written directly against the opening bracket of a flow sequence.
